canonical_project: PMICE fiber endpoint - Abeche transmission site
owner: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications); Huawei delivery partner
notes: Abeche is an eastern endpoint of the PMICE Phase I fiber line (Doba-Sarh-Am Timan-Abeche-Iriba) provisionally inaugurated at Sarh on 20 Dec 2025 (reception provisoire, Huawei present). PMICE 2020 route plan includes Abeche (Doba-Koumra-Sarh-Kyabe-Am Timan-Abeche-Am Zoer-Guereda-Iriba). Final technical reception of the 200 PMICE transmission sites pending per 2026 reporting. Classified PMICE transmission/fiber site, NOT commercial DC.
